parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return for this request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to start the next query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.
